    A label-aligned indecomposable skeleton of the primitive quotient #

    The indecomposable right modules over A / AeA are indexed literally by the ambient skeleton labels annihilated by AeA. This file realizes those labels inside the quotient module category and supplies the complete donor skeleton needed to form intrinsic irreducible-Hom spaces. No quotient-only relabeling is introduced.
